title: sparked smp
description: This server is an oceania smp it has pvp. It has a few minor mods like easy gaps, click mobs, mace cooldown, infinite villager trading, faster happy ghasts and true ending.
body:
The sparked smp is a decently PvP-based server set in sydney australia so oceania gets good ping, but you can still have fun if you aren't a PvPer. It has a few minor mods like easy gaps, click mobs, mace cooldown, infinite villager trading, faster happy ghasts, and true ending. The server is active with prime hours reaching 15 players. The server has rules such as no major grefing and no major stealing. Exploits are strictly prohibited.

join our discord server for all the rules and if you have any questions.
